Can I personalise the Patterned Leash designs with my dog's name and contact information?

No, there's no personalisation option available for the Patterned Leash designs. If you wish to add your pup's name and your contact details, please choose from a Personalised Leash design.

What materials are the leashes made from?

Our leashes are made from durable polyester webbing that is quick-dry and easy to clean with soap and water.

Are the leashes suitable for all dog sizes?

Yes, our leashes are designed to be perfect for every sized dog.

description.html:
Dog Leash Size:

  • Total length: 1.4m
  • Length of personalised section: 35cm
  • Width: 3cm

Upgrade your pup's style with our super fun and stylish Personalised Leashes! Perfect for every pooch, from tiny pupperinos to burly Boxers, these leashes are sure to make tails wag.

Our patterned options are vibrant and full of personality, with loads of designs to choose from. Each leash is designed to match perfectly with our Patterned Collars and Premium Dog Tags, making your dog the trendsetter of the park.

Want something unique? Our personalised leashes feature your dog's name and up to two contact details on a solid or two-toned leash. Clear and easy to read, they provide an extra layer of safety in the event your dog wanders off. Now your pup can strut in style with your contact information always visible!

Both options are made from durable polyester webbing that's quick-dry and easy to clean with soap and water. Whether you go for patterned or personalised, you're getting a dog lead that'll last for years and years!

Plus, here's a pro-tip! Make your walks more enjoyable & hassle-free when you add a Poop Bag Roll Pouch!

Please Note: Whatever you type in the personalisation fields will be what is printed, so please make sure to double-check your spelling.

short_description.html:
Your pup deserves the best and that includes their dog leash! Get them these sturdy and vibrant Personalised Leashes.

Whether you prefer the patterned option or the personalised one, these durable dog leads are sure to make every walk fun and comfy. Plus, you have the option to add your pup's name and your contact details.

Choose from heaps of super fun designs and colours now! We'll print and ship them in a flash anywhere in Australia.
